name: Atlas
install: curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash && export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun" && export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH" && (command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1 && sudo ln -sf "$BUN_INSTALL/bin/bun" /usr/local/bin/bun && sudo ln -sf "$BUN_INSTALL/bin/bunx" /usr/local/bin/bunx || true) && bun install
